scope: Actual source-image follow-up for three same-codex orthographic leads; no critical text selection or canonical application

method.observation_lane: single-agent context-informed image observation, after known spellings and publisher explanations
method.fresh_transcription_acceptance: held for independent blinded output and reconciliation

baseline.relationship: UXLC and WLC are digital transcriptions of the same Leningrad tradition, not two independent manuscripts

acquisition.route: Ordinary HTTPS full JPEGs using publisher-documented filename convention; subsequently confirmed against exact actual responses from documented Sefaria manuscript API
acquisition.failure_log: Web text opener failed safety resolution on public publisher change pages; ordinary capped HTTPS requests to the identical URLs succeeded. No authentication/access-denial bypass.
acquisition.api_source_link_caveat: Sefaria's source URL /wsrp/biblical-manuscripts currently serves USC Dead Sea Scrolls page; linked actual Biblical Manuscripts page is /wsrp/biblical-manuscripts-2/. Neither page is a photo-specific license.

rights.image_credit: Bruce Zuckerman / West Semitic Research, in collaboration with Ancient Biblical Manuscript Center; courtesy Russian National Library, Saltykov-Schedrin (Sefaria API attribution)
rights.tanach_license_boundary: Biblical Hebrew reusable; other site files separately restricted. Text permission is not treated as image permission.
rights.policy: Private research copies and exact non-generative crops only; source URLs and attribution recorded, no public image embed or redistribution

manuscript_metadata.identity: Leningrad Codex / Firkovich B19A, Russian National Library

cases.publisher_claim: Extra yod with lighter lower portion, possibly flaking; BHL body lacks it, Appendix A proposes it uncertainly
cases.own_visual_observation: Separate short dark head/stroke at consonantal writing height between mem and tav, with paler/irregular lower portion, distinct from below-line hiriq
cases.context_informed_inference: Supports extra yod, with damage caution
cases.not_observed_or_proven: Physical cause of pale area; flaking remains publisher explanation; BHL not independently inspected
cases.strongest_counter: Small trace could be misread because of damage or contextual expectation; not blinded
cases.english_consequence: No change established: putting him to death remains the same action/person/object; terminal paragraph-marker diagnostic is separate

cases.publisher_claim: Additional unpointed yod after resh; BHL body has two yods, appendix has three
cases.own_visual_observation: Distinct short consonantal stroke between resh and nun, separate from first yod after bet and later yod before vav; not a below-line point
cases.context_informed_inference: Supports third-yod spelling; clearer separation than Samuel
cases.not_observed_or_proven: No new vowel/syllable inferred; BHL not independently inspected
cases.strongest_counter: Misclassification of a short stroke or prior textual expectation remains possible without blind assessment
cases.english_consequence: No change established to fortresses and towers; extra yod alone does not identify a different building type

cases.publisher_claim: Remove vav and put holam on kaf; displayed Hebrew/action agree but Unicode prose repeats vav erroneously
cases.own_visual_observation: Lamed-alef-kaf-lamed with elevated holam and no separate consonantal vav in the legible region between kaf and final lamed
cases.context_informed_inference: Supports defective spelling; no positive visible support for extra vav
cases.not_observed_or_proven: No new pronunciation claimed; BHL not independently inspected
cases.strongest_counter: A very faint or conflated vav could theoretically be missed; no affirmative evidence for one in viewed crop
cases.english_consequence: No change established to finished eating; compared pointings express the same infinitive

transformation_log.whole_page_display: view_image automatically reduced full pages for layout inspection; those display resizes are not saved source derivatives
transformation_log.six_saved_crops: Pillow Image.open(raw).crop(box).save(PNG); exact original decoded pixels, no scaling, rotation, color change, interpolation, sharpening, OCR, thresholding, inpainting or generated content
transformation_log.crop_coordinates: zero-based top-left left/top/right/bottom; right and bottom exclusive; raw image pixel frame
transformation_log.crop_visual_inspection: all three context and three word PNGs actually viewed at native dimensions; word crops retain some neighbor fragments, context crops control identity
transformation_log.pixel_equivalence_check: PASS: six crop.tobytes() equal raw.crop(box).tobytes(); operation integrity only, not linguistic validation

remaining_gates: Independent blinded image assessment with actual outputs stored
Explicit source-label/application decision before any canonical repair
Image-specific reuse clearance before public image redistribution
